# @ndigo/inspect

Deterministic JSON manifest generator for Ndigo applications (routes, mappings, config keys)

Version-matched export index for the installed package. Read `README.md`
for usage; the workspace guide index ships with `@ndigo/cli` as
`assets/agent/docs-index.md`.

## Public exports

- `inspectApplication` — Build a deterministic, versioned manifest from an application context.
- `InspectApp` *(type)* — The application identity block: the context name (when it has one) and the active profile set.
- `InspectConfigEntry` *(type)* — A configuration key a `@configurationProperties` class declares.
- `InspectDispatcherLike` *(type)* — A dispatcher-like object whose `handlerMappings` collection carries the registered handler mappings (e.g. an `AbstractDispatcher`).
- `InspectHandler` *(type)* — The handler a mapping dispatches to.
- `InspectInput` *(type)* — The input to "inspect-application".inspectApplication.
- `InspectManifest` *(type)* — The deterministic, versioned application manifest.
- `InspectManifestVersion` *(type)* — The manifest schema version. Bumped when the emitted shape changes incompatibly; consumers switch on it.
- `InspectMapping` *(type)* — A registered handler mapping: the pattern it claims, the HTTP methods it accepts, and the handler method it resolves to. Values are never emitted.
- `InspectMappingTable` *(type)* — A handler-mapping read model: the enumeration seam an `AbstractHandlerMethodMapping` exposes. A structural subset, so callers may pass any mapping that provide…
- `InspectParameter` *(type)* — A handler method parameter and the source it binds from.
- `InspectRoute` *(type)* — A declarative route definition as emitted by the manifest.
- `MappingSource` *(type)* — A source of handler mappings: one or more mapping tables, or a dispatcher whose `handlerMappings` are inspected.
- `RouteSource` *(type)* — A source of declarative routes: a `RouteRegistry`, an iterable of keyed `[key, RouteDefinition]` entries (the shape `RouteRegistry.entries()` yields), an itera…
